digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter outbound comment send path
propositions: Jira DataCenter outbound comment send path does not apply length fitting, causing over-length comments to be rejected and re-emitted in each sync pass
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment has no production caller and is not wired into JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment, the transport delegate
The marker-preserving fit composition used in Cloud's send path must be reused for DC, recomposing sanitize_comment to apply fit_preserving_marker over the DC-specific ceiling
_DCSanitizer.fit_comment must be re-derived via fit_comment_as_sent to ensure the dedup key matches the marker-stripped body that actually lands on the wire
Cloud's dead sanitize_comment chain and FieldSanitizer.sanitize_comment protocol member should be removed to prevent future misuse
